candidates.source_name: Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës (ASK) — official website / institutional portal
candidates.why_relevant: The legally mandated national statistical office of Kosovo and the root portal from which every demand-side series in this cell (household budget, ICT usage, SILC, prices, business register, national accounts) branches. Trilingual (sq/sr/en) and the entry point to the ASKdata PxWeb database, release calendar, metadata and PDF publication API host.
candidates.legal_status: official public statistics; reuse normally permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of /Releases and /Themes indexes in all three language paths (/sq/, /sr/, /en/); harvest linked PDFs from askapi.rks-gov.net/Custom/*.pdf
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from search results
queries_used: Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës anketa e buxhetit të ekonomive familjare ask.rks-gov.net
ASK anketa e përdorimit të TIK-ut individë dhe familje Kosovë statistika

candidates.source_name: ASKdata — PxWeb statistical database (Kosovo Agency of Statistics)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-queryable PxWeb warehouse holding the actual tables behind ASK publications, including dedicated folders 'Household Budget Survey', 'ICT in Households and Enterprise', 'Income and Living Conditions', 'Price', 'Statistical business register', 'Structural business statistics', 'National and government accounts', 'Short-term statistics'. PxWeb exposes a standard JSON-stat API, making this the single most automatable demand-side source in the cell.
candidates.legal_status: official statistics, free reuse with source citation
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PxWeb API (px-web /api/v1/{lang}/ASKdata/... JSON-stat POST queries) or CSV/XLSX export per table; mirror the sq, sr and en language trees
candidates.discovered_via_method: web search + fetch of database root
queries_used: askdata.rks-gov.net PxWeb Kosovo Agency of Statistics database

candidates.source_name: ASK — Anketa e Buxhetit të Ekonomive Familjare (ABEF) / Household Budget Survey
candidates.why_relevant: The only official household-level evidence base for consumption structure in Kosovo (total consumption ~EUR 2,527m in 2022; ~EUR 8,106 per household). COICOP breakdown is the demand-side denominator for card-spend penetration and for sizing merchant categories; complements CBK supply-side payment counts.
candidates.legal_status: official statistics; microdata likely require a formal request/confidentiality agreement
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Pull the 'Household Budget Survey' PxWeb folder tables; supplement with the ABEF PDF report per survey round from askapi.rks-gov.net
queries_used: Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës anketa e buxhetit të ekonomive familjare ask.rks-gov.net
local_language_terms_used: Anketa e Buxhetit të Ekonomive Familjare

candidates.source_name: ASK — Anketa e përdorimit të TIK-ut në ekonomitë familjare dhe individë (ICT usage survey, households/individuals)
candidates.why_relevant: Eurostat-model ICT survey covering the 16-74 population: internet and device access, internet use, e-shopping and e-government. This is the official series for digital-channel readiness and online-purchase behaviour underpinning e-commerce/card-not-present potential. Latest reporting indicates ~99.3% household internet access in 2025.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the ITC theme page and the 'ICT in Households and Enterprise' PxWeb folder; archive each annual PDF release
queries_used: ASK anketa e përdorimit të TIK-ut individë dhe familje Kosovë statistika

candidates.source_name: ASK — ICT usage in enterprises (TIK në ndërmarrje) tables
candidates.why_relevant: The PxWeb folder is explicitly named 'ICT in Households and Enterprise', implying an enterprise-side ICT/e-commerce module — the merchant-side counterpart showing which businesses sell online/accept electronic orders. Directly relevant to POS/e-commerce acceptance sizing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate tables under the 'ICT in Households and Enterprise' folder via PxWeb API and separate household vs enterprise tables
candidates.discovered_via_method: inference from PxWeb folder listing (enterprise release not directly confirmed in search)
queries_used: ASK Kosovo "TIK" ndërmarrjet ICT usage enterprises e-commerce survey results release

candidates.source_name: ASK — Anketa e të Ardhurave dhe Kushteve të Jetesës (SILC / Income and Living Conditions)
candidates.why_relevant: Income distribution, material deprivation and ability-to-pay indicators; the standard covariate set for explaining financial exclusion and cash reliance among low-income households. Present as its own PxWeb folder ('Income and Living Conditions').
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF release + PxWeb 'Income and Living Conditions' folder
queries_used: ASK anketa e përdorimit të TIK-ut individë dhe familje Kosovë statistika
local_language_terms_used: Anketa mbi të Ardhurat dhe Kushtet e Jetesës

candidates.source_name: ASK — Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HIPC) / Indeksi i Çmimeve të Konsumit, Serbian-language releases
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly price series (HIPC base 2015=100, prices collected in 10 municipalities incl. via internet and telephone). Deflator for any nominal payment-value series and an indicator of retail price/channel structure. Confirms ASK publishes the same releases under a full Serbian-language path (/sr/agencija-za-statistiku-kosova/).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of the /sr/ and /sq/ release paths plus the 'Price' PxWeb folder
queries_used: "Agencija za statistiku Kosova" OR "Zavod za statistiku" Kosovo anketa o potrošnji domaćinstava indeks potrošačkih cijena

candidates.source_name: ASK — Statistical Business Register / Repertori Statistikor i Ndërmarrjeve (monthly)
candidates.why_relevant: Monthly statistical repertory of businesses registered with ARBK, plus the RSB covering all public and private enterprises operating in Kosovo. Gives merchant-universe counts by NACE activity, size and municipality — the denominator for POS terminal penetration and acquiring addressable market.
candidates.legal_status: official statistics; unit-level register data confidential
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly PDF harvest from askapi.rks-gov.net/Custom/*.pdf linked off the ASK release calendar, plus 'Statistical business register' PxWeb folder
queries_used: ASK Kosovo "Regjistri Statistikor i Ndërmarrjeve" statistikat e ndërmarrjeve strukturore publikim

candidates.source_name: ASK — Structural Business Statistics (Statistikat Strukturore të Ndërmarrjeve)
candidates.why_relevant: Turnover, value added and employment by NACE activity — sizes the retail/hospitality/services sectors that generate card-acceptance volume, and lets payment values be benchmarked against total sector turnover.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PxWeb 'Structural business statistics' folder + annual PDF publication
queries_used: ASK Kosovo "Regjistri Statistikor i Ndërmarrjeve" statistikat e ndërmarrjeve strukturore publikim

candidates.source_name: ASK — Short-term statistics (retail/services turnover indices)
candidates.why_relevant: Quarterly/monthly turnover indices for trade and services give a high-frequency comparator against payment-transaction growth, useful for detecting cash-to-card substitution independent of CBK data.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PxWeb 'Short-term statistics' folder via API
queries_used: askdata.rks-gov.net PxWeb Kosovo Agency of Statistics database

candidates.source_name: ASK — National and government accounts (GDP, household final consumption expenditure)
candidates.why_relevant: Household final consumption expenditure in the national accounts is the macro denominator for cash-versus-non-cash ratios (payment value / HFCE) and for currency-in-circulation-to-consumption metrics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PxWeb 'National and government accounts' folder; cross-check with ASK GDP PDF releases
queries_used: askdata.rks-gov.net PxWeb Kosovo Agency of Statistics database

candidates.source_name: ASK — External trade statistics
candidates.why_relevant: Import series for POS terminals, ATMs, card readers and related HS lines can proxy hardware deployment cycles in Kosovo — an indirect but independent read on terminal fleet renewal that no payments regulator publishes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: PxWeb 'External trade' folder queried at HS 8470/8472/8471 detail if available
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles category inference + PxWeb folder enumeration
queries_used: askdata.rks-gov.net PxWeb Kosovo Agency of Statistics database

candidates.source_name: ASK — Kalendari i Publikimeve (release calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: Forward schedule of every ASK release with delayed items flagged; the scheduling backbone for an automated collector — tells you when ABEF, TIK, SILC, HIPC and business-register outputs land, and warns of slippage.

candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable metadata export endpoint on the ASK CMS, exposing survey definitions, periodicity and methodology per statistical domain — ideal for building a source registry entry per series without hand-reading PDFs. Implies parallel _Sq/_En endpoints.
candidates.access_status: open (endpoint discovered via search index, liveness unverified)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch XML export per language, parse into the source registry; probe for ExportToXml_Sq and ExportToXml_En variants
candidates.discovered_via_method: Serbian-language search surfaced a non-obvious backend endpoint

candidates.why_relevant: The upstream administrative register that feeds ASK's statistical business register. negative_findings.description: No ASK survey or table was found that measures payment instrument choice at the point of sale (cash vs card vs transfer) in the way ECB SPACE or a diary study would.
negative_findings.result_summary: ABEF captures consumption by COICOP purpose but, from everything surfaced, not the instrument used to pay; the TIK survey covers e-shopping incidence, not payment mix.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's headline hypothesis — ASK as the demand-side counterpart on cash usage — holds only indirectly. Any cash-usage read from ASK will be inferred (consumption minus card volumes), not measured, unless a payment-diary module exists in unpublished microdata.

negative_findings.description: Search for an ASK enterprise-side ICT/e-commerce survey release returned no ASK-hosted result; all hits were Eurostat/INE/CyStat equivalents.
negative_findings.result_summary: The PxWeb folder is named 'ICT in Households and Enterprise', implying enterprise tables exist, but no enterprise release page or PDF was located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Merchant-side e-commerce adoption is the direct input to acquiring/CNP sizing; if ASK does not field the enterprise module, that evidence must come from CBK or private sources instead.

negative_findings.description: ABEF periodicity changed from annual to multi-year.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian-language sources state that from 2015 the household consumption survey moved from annual collection to a two-to-three-year cycle.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector scheduled for annual ABEF updates will produce false 'missing data' alarms; consumption denominators must be interpolated between rounds using national accounts HFCE instead.

negative_findings.description: Microdata access route for ABEF, SILC and TIK was not established in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: No public microdata catalogue, anonymised-file request form or research-access policy for ASK surveys was surfaced by the queries run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cross-tabulating cash behaviour by income decile or urban/rural requires microdata; without a documented access route this remains a manual, relationship-based ask to ASK (infoask@rks-gov.net).

negative_findings.description: ASKdata PxWeb uses ASP.NET __doPostBack navigation, so subject folders have no stable deep-link URLs in the rendered HTML.
negative_findings.result_summary: The fetched database root listed 26 subject areas but exposed no per-folder hrefs; only the Geographical data folder appeared with a canonical /pxweb/en/ASKdata/ASKdata__<Folder>/ path via search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: HTML scraping of ASKdata will be brittle. The collector should target the PxWeb REST API path pattern (/api/v1/{lang}/ASKdata/...) rather than the web UI.

negative_findings.description: No distinct Serbian-language institution named 'Zavod za statistiku Kosova' exists; the correct Serbian rendering is 'Agencija za statistiku Kosova'.
negative_findings.result_summary: The seed query using 'Zavod za statistiku' returned Montenegrin (MONSTAT) and Croatian (DZS) offices; only 'Agencija za statistiku Kosova' resolves to ASK's own /sr/ path.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Using the wrong Serbian alias pulls in neighbouring countries' statistics and contaminates any automated query set. 'Zavod za statistiku' should be flagged as a noisy term for XK.

coverage_gaps.description: No demand-side measurement of ATM withdrawal behaviour or cash-holding habits from the statistics office.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm with ASK whether any ABEF module records payment method; otherwise route ATM/POS demand evidence to the CBK cell and treat ASK only as denominator provider.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of ASK content was confirmed to exist (/sr/ path, HIPC releases, metadata XML) but was not enumerated series-by-series; no Serbian-language third-party analyst source for Kosovo statistics was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated /sr/ crawl of ask.rks-gov.net release pages and check whether the Serbian tree lags the Albanian one; also probe northern-municipality Serbian media as a secondary channel.

coverage_gaps.description: PxWeb API endpoint pattern and rate limits for askdata.rks-gov.net are assumed from the standard PxWeb product, not confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe /api/v1/en/ASKdata/ and /api/v1/sq/ASKdata/ during the deterministic verification pass; record the actual API version and any throttling before scheduling bulk pulls.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-ASK official demand-side actors in this cell were not explored: the Kosovo tax administration (ATK) fiscal-cash-register/e-invoicing data and the telecom regulator (ARKEP) subscriber statistics.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up sweep for ATK (Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës) fiscal cash register/e-fatura reporting and ARKEP quarterly market reports — both are administrative proxies for merchant electronic acceptance and mobile penetration.

coverage_gaps.description: International aggregators that republish and harmonise ASK series (Eurostat enlargement statistics, World Bank Findex, UNECE, IMF) were not covered in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Register Eurostat's enlargement-country tables and World Bank Global Findex as aggregator sources; Findex in particular carries account ownership and digital-payment usage for Kosovo that ASK does not publish.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth and archival redundancy of ASK's GUID-named PDF store is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-register the Library of Congress web archive of ASK (loc.gov item lcwaN0014040) as a fallback archive for withdrawn or relocated releases.

brief: Kosovo's demand-side statistical landscape is highly centralised in one actor, the Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës (ASK / Agencija za statistiku Kosova), which publishes trilingually (sq/sr/en) across three technically distinct surfaces: a CMS release site (ask.rks-gov.net), a GUID-addressed PDF store (askapi.rks-gov.net) and a PxWeb warehouse (askdata.rks-gov.net) whose 26 subject folders include Household Budget Survey, ICT in Households and Enterprise, Income and Living Conditions, Structural business statistics and the Statistical business register — the last of these being the merchant-universe denominator for POS penetration work. The PxWeb layer is the automation target (standard JSON-stat API, CSV/XLSX export); the CMS layer should be crawled only for release detection via the Kalendari i Publikimeve, since its folder navigation is postback-based. The critical caveat for this run is that ASK appears to measure what households consume and whether they shop online, but not which instrument they pay with, so ASK supplies denominators and behavioural context for cash-versus-card analysis rather than a direct cash-usage measurement; ABEF's shift to a two-to-three-year cycle after 2015 further limits its use as a high-frequency series. Adjacent administrative actors — ARBK for the upstream business register (plus the civic arbk.org mirror), and the not-yet-swept ATK fiscal-cash-register and ARKEP telecom reporting — are the most promising extensions of this cell.
